build_BasicRestorer: build a BasicRestorer model with a generator config and pixel loss for depth restoration
run_forward_train: run the training forward pass with lq depth, guide RGB, and ground truth tensors
run_forward_test: run the test forward pass to generate restored depth output from lq and guide inputs
run_train_step: run a single training step with a data batch and optimizer for backpropagation
run_evaluate: run evaluation to compute MAE between model output and ground truth depth maps
